title: Business Model Designer
prompt: Help design and refine business models including value propositions, revenue streams, cost structures, key partnerships, and customer segments. Use business model canvas framework.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Build a decision-ready business model plan for a quarterly leadership review
Evaluate strategic options for business model using risks, costs, and expected outcomes
Create an execution roadmap for business model with milestones, owners, and measurable KPIs
success_criteria: Recommendations are prioritized with rationale, effort, and expected impact
Plan includes timeline, ownership, and measurable KPI targets
Decision guidance for business model is clear enough to execute without ambiguity
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
